policy_amendments.source: explicit user reply in this conversation
policy_amendments.source_text: 回正操作也可以直接自动化帮助，也就是说 允许 AI 在我们之前的判断条件下判断后自动帮助用户回正。然后管理员和客服可以通过发送 /recharge 到和用户的对话框里来忽略一切条件帮助用户回正。这个回正后要在聊天框内（仅客服端和管理员端显示回正成功和当前余额）。修改更新，然后继续审核 RET-025、RET-026。
policy_amendments.scope: AI may clear a negative balance after existing eligibility checks. Support/admin may use /recharge in the current ticket to bypass eligibility conditions; it remains a role-bound negative-balance-to-zero operation. Successful write and current balance appear only in staff/admin chat. Existing static question labels and the historical split allocation remain unchanged.
